description: This source file implements the BlindSignAuth class, providing methods for obtaining tokens, handling HTTP responses, creating cryptographic requests, and fingerprinting public metadata within a blind signature authentication process.

classes.name: BlindSignAuth
classes.description: Class providing methods for token retrieval, cryptographic request creation, response handling, and metadata fingerprinting in a blind signature authentication workflow.

methods.name: GetTokens
methods.description: Initiates a request to obtain blind tokens using OAuth token and number of tokens.

methods.name: GetInitialDataCallback
methods.description: Handles the response from the initial data request, creating cryptographic requests and proceeding with authentication.

methods.name: AuthAndSignCallback
methods.description: Processes the response from the authentication and signing request, unblinding tokens, and preparing spend token data.

methods.name: FingerprintPublicMetadata
methods.description: Generates a fingerprint of the public metadata using SHA-256 hash.
